'''Brute''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He chose to work as a [[Merchant/Legends|shoe salesman]], which, due to Gungans not wearing shoes, required him to leave his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Brute believed his vocation as a salesman was a noble and worthwhile endeavor, and one that brought him considerable satisfaction. It also earned him a large commission, and so in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he visited [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]] on [[Genarius]]&mdash;visiting the [[Grande Game]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]]&mdash;before continuing on to [[Tolea Biqua]].
